result:
If I could change one thing about the world, it would be to make empathy immediate and unavoidable.

Not more laws, not more technology, just a fundamental shift where people can actually feel, in a real and visceral way, the impact of their choices on other people. 

The distance between action and consequence is what lets harm scale. If you could instantly feel the exhaustion in the person picking your food, the anxiety in the person reading your words, the fear in the person affected by your policy or your silence, the world would change on its own. 

People would still disagree, still compete, still be flawed. But cruelty would become self-defeating, and kindness would become the default efficient choice.
